entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about returning a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Are you experiencing a technical fault, or is it more of a preference?
Oh, it's not a technical fault. The device seems to work fine. The issue is just with my timing. I know I'm outside the standard window, but I'm hoping we can negotiate something.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear there was a timing issue. Can you tell me when you originally received the product?
I believe it was delivered about 39 days ago. The thing is, I had a major family emergency right after it arrived. My father was rushed to the hospital and needed unexpected surgery.
I'm very sorry to hear about your father. I hope he's recovering well.

Thank you. He is. But right after that, I had a short-notice work deployment I couldn't get out of. The whole situation was just one big emergency, and this is the first chance I've had to deal with personal things like this. So, given the circumstances, I was hoping for maybe a store credit or even a partial refund?
I appreciate you sharing that, and I'm sorry you had to deal with all of that at once. Let me just pull up our return policy here... one moment.
Okay, I've got it. Actually, it looks like you don't need a special exception at all. Our policy for the VeloBand allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Ninety days? Are you sure? I thought I saw something online about it being much shorter.

Yes, I'm looking at the official knowledge base right now and it states a 90-day return window. Since you're only on day 39, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. No negotiation necessary.
Wow. Well, that's fantastic news. That's much simpler than I expected. Thank you so much, Charlie.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could clear that up for you. I'm sending the return shipping label to the email on your account now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
